notes.title: DEMO Patch dv 0.1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Update Notes – Version 0.1.0.2
[/b] [/h2][h3][b]• New Features[/b][/h3][p][b]New Character[/b]
A new skin has been added and can be unlocked by completing all objectives in the Mystic Forest.

[b]New Laser Sound Effects[/b]
Laser shots now feature new sound effects for a more immersive experience.

[/p][h3][b]• UI and Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][p][b]Objectives Now Visible in the Pause Menu[/b]
You can now view tips on how to earn 3 stars directly from the pause menu during gameplay.

[b]Alternative Keybindings Displayed in Settings[/b] 
Alternative keyboard keys are now listed in the settings menu.[/p][h3][b]• Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p][b]Destructible Platform Fix[/b]
The destructible platform will no longer respawn if the player is standing on it, preventing unwanted pushbacks.

[b]D-pad Fix[/b]
Fixed an issue with the D-pad not working correctly on controllers, ensuring more precise movement.[/p]

notes.title: DEMO Patch dv 0.1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Update Notes[/b][/h2]

[*] [b]Improved Controller Support[/b]  
You can now aim with the right analog stick without needing to hold the arrow charge button.

[*] [b]Door Mechanic Adjustment[/b]  
Players no longer get stuck when a door closes on them.

[*] [b]New Alternative Keyboard Controls[/b]  
We've added new keybinds for movement and jumping:  
1 - Move left/right: J / L or Left Arrow / Right Arrow  
2 - Jump: I or Up Arrow

[i]Note – we're working on a full input customization system, allowing you to remap controls however you like.[/i]

notes.title: Project Arrow Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the [b]demo[/b] of [b]Project Arrow[/b] is now [b]available[/b] here on Steam! 🐱🏹
Now you can try the game for free and get a glimpse of what we’re preparing:

[previewyoutube=_h8Hv3pBw_8;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Project Arrow[/b]
[list]
[*] Run, jump, and dodge dangers.
[*] Use your bow and arrow physics to solve puzzles and open paths.
[*] Face enemies with precision and timing.
[*] Discover secrets and collectibles.
[*] There are cats. 🐱
[/list]
Your feedback is super important so we can keep making the game better! So play, tell us what you think, and if you like it, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist, it really helps the project reach more people. 💖

Thank you very much!
Have fun!

notes.title: DEVLOG #01 | Rope Physics.
notes.notes:
[b]Project Arrow[/b] is a physics-based game, and one of the most exciting parts of its development was working on the rope physics. In the game, ropes hold rocks and platforms that are essential for the player to traverse the paths, and interacting with them is also really fun.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45033205/1a58f970f88ec86e4e122220b2177136402b73d4.gif[/img]

Players must shoot arrows to cut the ropes. Besides being a useful mechanic, it's incredibly satisfying to see the ropes snap. ːsteammockingː

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45033205/eeb905ca9d1684ccf4df8611abbd4b4d4cf76b99.gif[/img]

Sometimes, you'll need to be quick and precise.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45033205/fc1a4b3d22a06be2e6f63b7a0780153e654d2b81.gif[/img]

We have so much more to share, and I'll be posting updates here on Steam over time. We're excited to see you play the game and hear your feedback.
Thank you for checking out this post, and come back anytime!
ːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: DEVLOG #00 | Hello =)
notes.notes:
Hello!
We are Port Hope Games, and we are glad to present our first game: Project Arrow!

[b]Port Hope Games[/b]

We are an independent studio formed by two friends: Hicaro Lima (artist) and Josiel 'Zyel' Nascimento (programmer). Although we already have experience in the gaming industry, Project Arrow is our first project as a team, and we are excited to share its development with you.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45033205/887e14562502cf450347f4febb86b9988b544ba1.jpg[/img]

[b]Project Arrow[/b]

Project Arrow is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements that tells the story of a nameless cat lost in a mysterious world full of challenges. To progress, players need to use skill and precision, shooting arrows with calculated force and trajectory to solve puzzles and unlock new paths.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45033205/94cdddde4b36650dee947a398c298c9ea0a70800.png[/img]

We don’t have an exact release date for Project Arrow yet, but we can tell you it’s planned for the end of 2025. In the meantime, we’re working to release a demo soon, so you can try the game before the official launch.

Don’t forget to add Project Arrow to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408460/Project_Arrow/][b][u]Wishlist[/u][/b][/url]! It helps us a lot and ensures you won’t miss any updates.

We’ll be sharing the entire development process here and on our social media, so follow us to stay updated! ːsteamthumbsupː

Thank you =)
